underlying.note: The upstream this was ported from, awayjs/awayjs-examples, carries no licence declaration of any kind. The MIT above is the port's own declaration and covers the port's authorship; it does not establish that the bundled art was licensed to begin with. Recorded so the distinction survives, since these files are game assets rather than the port's original work.
